title: Listening Drill — Filming a short interview — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Filming a short interview — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on filming a short interview last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with low sound. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: loose plug.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of sound balance so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow memory card instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the video tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
